g.text: Cooperative memory changes what the carrier chooses to learn
A5-v2 finite two-region task • A4 sharing frozen • exact world and delivery enumeration

Dots: three paired checkpoints; large dot: mean. ¹No-sharing agents have no delivered evidence to duplicate. Exact reference optimizes the restricted carrier acquisition menu under frozen A4 and the fixed route executor.
Scope: noiseless finite information task; this figure does not evaluate two-region VMAS motion or port-Hamiltonian control.
